technology_name: BOF & IOT BASED ENGINEERED GEOPOLYMER COMPOSITE (EGC) FOR MAINLINE PRESTRESSED RAILWAY SLEEPERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard prestressed concrete railway sleepers rely strictly on carbon-heavy Ordinary Portland Cement (OPC), leading to massive greenhouse emissions and vulnerability to cyclic structural fatigue.
description: An eco-friendly Engineered Geopolymer Composite (EGC) formulation specifically engineered for mainline railway sleepers by blending Fly Ash (FA) and Basic Oxygen Furnace (BOF) slag reinforced with high-tensile steel fibers and iron ore tailings.
applications: High-speed railway track structural bases, heavy freight rail line infrastructure, prestressed urban transit sleepers, and industrial foundation pads.
secondary_sector: Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
